name: GPU & Display Latency Tuner
author: WinCare Core Team
description: Hardware-level graphics adapter optimization for AMD, NVIDIA, and Intel GPUs. Provides Ultra-Low Power State (ULPS) disablement, dynamic P-State frequency locking, and async flip latency minimization.

tools.title: AMD Radeon ULPS Disable
tools.summary: Disables Ultra-Low Power State (ULPS) in driver registry to prevent secondary card sleep lag, crossfire stutter, and wake crashes.

tools.title: NVIDIA Dynamic P-State Lock
tools.summary: Disables dynamic P-States (PowerMizer clock throttling) to lock GPU memory and core clocks during latency-critical workloads.

tools.title: Intel Graphics Async Flip Optimization
tools.summary: Disables asynchronous flip queue throttling on Intel UHD/Iris/Arc graphics to reduce DWM frame presentation latency.
